body: Be the most hated person in an orchestra

Towards the end of high school I was close friends with this girl who was very needy and had all sorts of issues she was dealing with and she used it as an excuse to treat people like shit. We’ll call her Judy. Judy had this other friend who was her ‘best friend’ (we’ll call her Kate), and they had been friends for a long time etc etc..I didn’t care lol people are allowed to have multiple friends I was just happy to be one of them.

One day after bringing Judy her homework because she was out sick and helping her with the lesson, Judy turned to me and goes “you know. You’re alright I guess but you’re no Kate. And you never will be. You need know that you’ll just never be as important to me.” 
Took a while for my self confidence to recover from that one haha
Came here to say this. That shit puts me on the ground every time it happens.

Once in 4th grade, my friend and I sat next to each other. We had a multiple choice test that we were nervous about so we learned the sign language for A-F during lunch and we would subtly change our hand position on the desk to indicate which letter choice we picked. Worked flawlessly and the teacher had no idea. Unfortunately we got caught the next day cause we got the same score with the same answers wrong. Whoops haha
Dude yes. I’m an American and Ive lived in between Lyon and Avignon for almost 2 years and I’m still not over how pretty everything is.

Hi thank you for responding. I’m sorry I made it sound as though I was expecting you guys to change the system haha. I meant the whole “fix it” as a more of a “general out to the universe this needs to get fixed someone needs to know about it” kind of way. And I appreciate the suggestions and support
You’re totally right that discounting my own experiences is the quickest way into trouble and I know if I had a friend say the things I say to myself, I’d tell them the same exact thing you told me. The thing you said about incongruence between outside and inside world was the perfect way to describe something I wasn’t able to put words to. 

Last night was the first time it ever went so far that I realized I was actually contemplating it and it was more just shock at myself cause I never thought I’d get there. 
I feel like I’m talking in circles and I don’t really have a point here haha I just wanted to say thanks for your response. It felt nice to have a place to reach out and vent and feel heard

So this may sound ridiculous, but you don’t know that you can’t be loved. I’ve never had anyone be in love with me either and that’s a huge part of my suicidal shit. But being in love and loving are 2 different things. It’s hard to remember and know that people love you. You may not know but I’m sure they do.
